outgoing.name: Cholera
outgoing.excerpt: The severe crop shortages left many villages on the brink of starvation, while lack of sanitation led to outbreaks of malaria, dengue fever, and cholera.

outgoing.name: Great Britain
outgoing.excerpt: Mitch became extratropical later that day, but it continued to persist for several days before losing its identity north of Great Britain on November 9.
